rationale: S-0076-01 proposes tier-stratifying channel densities in a follow-up Bed B MOBO across soma / proximal / mid / terminal dendritic regions, expanding the input to ~40-50 d, to test whether tier-stratification breaks the inherent DSI-vs-rate trade-off observed in the t0076 25-d uniform-density search. This is folded into t0078 (bedb_mobo_v2_ais_tiered_ahp) as the 5-tier stratification (soma, proximal, mid, terminal, AIS) for Nav1.6 / Kv3 / NaP / BK / SK, expanding the parameter space to the same 40-50 d range. Rejecting as covered by t0078.
